doc: Cutscene foley by listening (M3-AUD-817; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md "Cutscene foley"). CutsceneAudio (game/audio/cutscene_audio.gd) hears each CutsceneSequencer's cue_played and never writes it; nothing plays while it is_skipping(). anim: `@anim <actor> <clip>`: the clip name (exact first, then the first glob that matches) -> an sfx row, at the actor (CutsceneStage.actor) plus at_height_m. light: `@light <name> on|off`: the light name glob -> a row for on and for off, at the light; `off` plays only when the light was lit (the prologue starts by putting its lantern out unseen). vfx: `@vfx <effect> at=<place>`: the effect -> a row, at the place (CutsceneStage.place). '' silences a clip. Steps in cutscenes are the actors' own FootstepAudio (the director attaches one to every CutsceneStage.cast() member).

lamps._note: M3-AUD-847: a stage's lit lamps (Light3D nodes whose names match, globs) crackle at the lamp at a random gap of every_sec while visible and lit: Rhen's lantern at the Iskarra vigil
